queries.name: worker_jobs_by_stage
queries.sql: SELECT LifecycleStage, CertificationStatus, COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_jobs FROM dbo.Sys_Worker_Jobs GROUP BY LifecycleStage, CertificationStatus ORDER BY LifecycleStage, CertificationStatus

queries.name: worker_incidents_by_state
queries.sql: SELECT IncidentState, Severity, COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_incidents FROM dbo.Sys_Worker_Incidents GROUP BY IncidentState, Severity ORDER BY IncidentState, Severity

queries.name: worker_capabilities_summary
queries.sql: SELECT CapabilityKind, CertificationStatus, COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_capabilities FROM dbo.Sys_Worker_Capabilities GROUP BY CapabilityKind, CertificationStatus ORDER BY CapabilityKind, CertificationStatus

objective: Consultar estado operativo SQL canónico de Worker Console posterior a M2 R3, agregados de trabajos, incidentes y capacidades, sin modificar datos ni producción.
